lines.en: label futabaspecial60p3:
scene futabatired1
A wise man once said “Knowledge is power.”
lines.zh: 一位智者曾经说过「知识就是力量」。

lines.en: But I'm not very wise. So {i}I{/i} say, “Knowledge is annoying.”
lines.zh: 但{i}我{/i}并不怎么聪明。所以我说：「知识很烦。」

lines.en: Not just because it eats up a good portion of my daily life now, though. It’s more so the fact that learning about some guys with weird hair who existed a long time ago isn’t going to change anything.
lines.zh: 不过不只是因为它现在占掉了我日常生活的一大块。更多的是因为，去了解一些很久以前存在过的、发型奇怪的家伙，并不会改变任何事。

lines.en: Or...at least it wouldn’t change anything in most contexts. Frankly, knowing more about the past iterations of {i}me{/i} might change my behavior in some way, but...in most contexts, history is just history.
lines.zh: 或者……至少在大多数情况下它改变不了什么。坦白说，多了解一些{i}我{/i}过去的版本，也许会以某种方式改变我的行为，但是……在大多数情况下，历史就是历史。

lines.en: The past (Again, in most contexts) will only repeat to a certain extent.
lines.zh: 过去（再说一次，在大多数情况下）只会在一定程度上重演。

lines.en: And learning things like when a castle was seized or some man was executed isn’t going to prevent things like that from happening in the future.
lines.zh: 而了解某座城堡何时被攻陷、某个人何时被处决之类的事，并不能阻止那种事在未来发生。

lines.en: Wherever man exists, turmoil will follow.
lines.zh: 只要有人的地方，动荡就会随之而来。

lines.en: And for that reason, I will continue to zone out as Imani speaks and pay more attention to Kirin slowly unbuttoning her shirt while staring at me.
lines.zh: 正因如此，我会继续在 Imani 讲课时走神，把更多的注意力放在 Kirin 一边盯着我、一边慢慢解开她衬衫的纽扣上。

lines.en: I wonder how far she’ll go?
lines.zh: 我好奇她会做到哪一步？

lines.en: : ...and while the seizure of Heiankyo, or “Kyoto” as we refer to it today, brought an end to the Warring States period, Nobu-kun still had a bunch of work to do in terms of stabilizing Japan.
lines.zh: : ……虽然平安京——也就是我们今天所说的「京都」——的陷落为战国时代画上了句号，但 Nobu-kun 在稳定日本方面还有一大堆事要做。

lines.en: : So with this brand new territory added to his ever-growing list of cool hang-out spots, he set his sights on the remaining Ashikaga shogunate, but would not finish the job until five years later.
lines.zh: : 于是，随着这片全新的领地被加进他那张越来越长的「酷炫据点」清单，他把目光投向了残存的足利幕府，但要直到五年之后才完成这件事。

lines.en: : Now, for extra credit on the test we aren’t going to take on this, can anyone tell me the {i}name{/i} of the final Ashikaga shogun?
lines.zh: : 那么，作为我们并不会考的那场考试的附加分，有谁能告诉我最后一位足利将军的{i}名字{/i}？

lines.en: : Yes! Pick me!
lines.zh: : 我！选我！

lines.en: : Can anyone {i}who hasn’t answered every single other question{/i} tell me the name of the final Ashikaga shogun?
lines.zh: : 有没有哪位{i}没有把前面每个问题都答过一遍{/i}的人，能告诉我最后一位足利将军的名字？

lines.en: : I can!
lines.zh: : 我可以！

lines.en: scene futabatired2
: Then, Kirin-
lines.zh: : 那么，Kirin——

lines.en: scene futabatired3
: Bitch, what you doin’ over there? Button up yo’ God damn shirt.
lines.zh: : 贱人，你在那边搞什么呢？把你他妈的衬衫扣好。

lines.en: : Oh, whoops.
lines.zh: : 哦，哎呀。

lines.en: : “Whoops” my ass. You know better than to strip in class. I bet you don’t even know the name of the shogun, do you? You were just trying to make me lose my job.
lines.zh: : 「哎呀」个屁。你明知道不该在课堂上脱衣服。我打赌你连将军的名字都不知道，对吧？你就是想害我丢了工作。

lines.en: : I {i}do{/i} know actually. It’s Ashikaga Yoshiaki. And, if you want his parents’ names as well, they were Ashikaga Yoshiharu and the daughter of Konoe Hisamichi, Keiju-in.
lines.zh: : 其实我知道。是足利义昭。而且，如果你还{i}想{/i}要他父母的名字的话，是足利义晴，以及近卫尚通之女、庆寿院。

lines.en: scene futabatired4
: Man, see what you’re capable of when you quench your thirst? That was a genuinely good answer. Ten points to the second floor.
lines.zh: : 哥们，看看你解了渴之后多有能耐？这确实是个好答案。给二楼加十分。

lines.en: scene futabatired5
: Points?! Nobody said there would be points! But surely my floor must have more than the other on account of how many correct answers I’ve had today.
lines.zh: : 分数？！没人说过会有分数啊！不过看我今天答对了这么多，我们楼层肯定得分更多吧。

lines.en: : Nah. Score’s ten to zip right now. But you’ll have plenty of time to catch up.
lines.zh: : 没。目前比分是十比零。不过你有的是时间追上来。

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei？

lines.en: scene futabatired6
: Yeah? What-
lines.zh: : 嗯？什么——

lines.en: scene futabatired7
: Woah, what the hell happened to {i}you?{/i}
lines.zh: : 哇，{i}你{/i}到底怎么了？

lines.en: : Can I borrow you for a minute? In private, please.
lines.zh: : 能借你一分钟吗？私下谈，拜托。

lines.en: : Jesus, Futaba. You look like you were hit by a truck. Shouldn’t you go to the nurse’s office instead?
lines.zh: : 天啊，Futaba。你看起来像被卡车撞过。你不是该去保健室吗？

lines.en: : That won’t be necessary, Miss Imai. I just need to talk to Sensei for a minute. It won’t take very long.
lines.zh: : 那倒不必，Imai 老师。我只需要和 Sensei 谈一分钟。不会太久的。

lines.en: : Is...everything alright?
lines.zh: : 你……还好吗？

lines.en: : Bro, look at her. You really think everything is alright? Hell nah. We’ve gotta find the truck driver who did this. Ain’t nobody messing with my girls during school hours.
lines.zh: : 兄弟，看看她。你真觉得她还好吗？想都别想。我们得把撞她的那个卡车司机找出来。上课时间谁也别想动我的姑娘们。

lines.en: : Sensei? Now?
lines.zh: : Sensei？现在？

lines.en: scene black
: Sorry, Imani. I can’t head the class anymore. You’re going to have to take over for me.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Imani。这课我教不下去了。你得替我顶上。

lines.en: : This {i}motherfucker{/i} really just said, “I can’t head the class anymore.” Ain’t no way. While I’ve got the stick in my hand and everything.
lines.zh: : 这{i}狗娘养的{/i}居然就这么说了句「这课我教不下去了」。没门。我手里还拿着教鞭之类的东西呢。

lines.en: : I’m glad you understand. Come on, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 很高兴你理解。走吧，Futaba。

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. Guess I’ll just keep doing the same damn thing I’ve been doing this whole- Kirin! Button your damn uniform! I ain’t telling you again!
lines.zh: : 行，行。看来我只能继续干我一直在干的该死的事了——Kirin！把你的该死的校服扣好！我不想再说第二遍！

lines.en: : Booooooo! Free the nipple! Imani’s not progressive enough!
lines.zh: : 嘘——！解放乳头！Imani 不够进步！

lines.en: : Y’all really just ignoring the stick, huh?
lines.zh: : 你们是真把教鞭当空气啊，是吧？

lines.en: scene futabatired8
: Just a little tired, that’s all.
lines.zh: : 只是有点累，就这样。

lines.en: : You didn’t even give me a chance to say anything.
lines.zh: : 你连让我说话的机会都没给。

lines.en: : I already knew what you were going to say. And also, thanks for letting me talk to you in here outside of your regular office hours. I realize that must be kind of annoying for you.
lines.zh: : 我已经知道你要说什么了。还有，谢谢你愿意在你正常的办公时间之外，让我在这儿跟你说话。我知道这对你来说肯定有点烦。

lines.en: : Well, it’s not like you show up {i}during{/i} office hours anymore...so this is nice. It’ll let us catch up a bit. Which, by the look of it, we kind of {i}need{/i} to.
lines.zh: : 嗯，反正你现在也不在{i}办公时间{/i}出现了……所以这样挺好。能让我们稍微叙叙旧。而看样子，我们还真{i}需要{/i}。

lines.en: : Yes, I bet you’re wondering why I dragged you away from the class. Or why I didn’t do my hair today. Or anything else you might be wondering because I’m clearly not acting like myself.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我猜你在想我为什么把你从课堂上拽出来。或者我今天为什么没弄头发。或者任何别的你可能会好奇的事，因为我明显不像平时的我。

lines.en: : And I know that. I’m well aware of it. Rin told me the same exact thing when she got home last night. Minus the hair part because I'd done my hair earlier that day.
lines.zh: : 而我知道。我非常清楚。Rin 昨晚回家的时候跟我说了完全一样的话。除了头发那部分，因为那天早些时候我已经弄过头发了。

lines.en: : But anyway, when I explained to her {i}the reason{/i} I was acting differently, she just went to sleep upstairs instead. I wonder why?
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，当我跟她解释我{i}为什么{/i}表现不一样的时候，她只是上楼睡觉去了。我想知道为什么？

lines.en: : Did...something happen?
lines.zh: : 发生……什么事了吗？

lines.en: scene futabatired9
: Why, yes. What gave it away?
lines.zh: : 哦，是啊。是什么让你看出来的？

lines.en: Futaba’s eyes, which are normally so full of life, now appear more like those of a dying fish or a creature from the pages of some sort of horror manga.
lines.zh: Futaba 那双平时充满生机的眼睛，现在看起来更像一条垂死的鱼的眼睛，或者某部恐怖漫画书页里爬出来的生物。

lines.en: She stares through me. And, for the first time since I’ve met her, I feel...intimidated.
lines.zh: 她的目光穿透了我。而自从我认识她以来，我第一次感到……畏惧。

lines.en: But I also feel like this doesn’t have anything to do with me.
lines.zh: 但我也觉得，这跟我没什么关系。

lines.en: There’s no murderous intent in those lifeless fish eyes — just a tinge of desperation and...
lines.zh: 那双毫无生气的鱼眼里没有杀意——只有一丝绝望，还有……

lines.en: Hopelessness.
lines.zh: 无助。

lines.en: And I {i}know{/i} hopelessness. I’d recognize it from a mile away. Some may even call me an expert.
lines.zh: 而我{i}了解{/i}无助。一英里之外我就能认出它。有些人甚至会称我是专家。

lines.en: But what would make {i}this{/i} girl feel that way?
lines.zh: 可是什么会让{i}这个{/i}女孩有这种感觉？

lines.en: : Wow. You look just as bad as I do right now.
lines.zh: : 哇。你现在看起来和我一样糟。

lines.en: : I think that’s on you. I’m not exactly fond of staring at you when you look like this.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那是你自己的问题。我可不太喜欢看你这副样子。

lines.en: : Do you not think I’m a butterfly?
lines.zh: : 你不觉得我是一只蝴蝶吗？

lines.en: : ...What?
: Would I stand out in an eclipse? Am I moving too far away from the mouth of the sky?
lines.zh: : 我会在一场月食中脱颖而出吗？我是不是正离天空的入口越来越远？

lines.en: : Uhh...what-
: It doesn’t matter. But I have news for you. Bad news. News that puts you and everyone else in danger.
lines.zh: : 那不重要。不过我有消息要告诉你。坏消息。会让你和其他所有人陷入危险的消息。

lines.en: : It’s not about the end of the world, is-
lines.zh: : 不是关于世界末日的，是——

lines.en: : I have news for you. Bad news. News that puts you and everyone else in danger.
lines.zh: : 我有消息要告诉你。坏消息。会让你和其他所有人陷入危险的消息。

lines.en: Well...I guess it’s not that.
lines.zh: 嗯……看来不是那个。

lines.en: : What’s the news, Futaba?...
lines.zh: : 什么消息，Futaba？……

lines.en: : It’s Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 是 Nodoka。

lines.en: : She knows everything.
lines.zh: : 她什么都知道。

lines.en: : None of our secrets are safe. None of them.
lines.zh: : 我们的秘密一个都不安全了。一个都不。

lines.en: : Are you not going to say anything?
lines.zh: : 你什么都不打算说吗？

lines.en: : You found out about her book, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 你发现她那本书了，对吧？

lines.en: scene futabatired10
: You {i}knew?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你{i}早就{/i}知道？

lines.en: : I did. Just like I knew she was trying to keep it from you because “you wouldn’t understand” or something like that.
lines.zh: : 是。就像我也知道，她在试图瞒着你，因为「你不会理解」之类的。

lines.en: : So...you’re fully aware that Nodoka is {i}publishing a book{/i} where you go around {i}sleeping with your students...{/i}and you’re just...okay with it?
lines.zh: : 所以……你完全清楚 Nodoka 正在{i}出版一本{/i}写着你{i}到处和学生上床{/i}的书……而你竟然就……无所谓？

lines.en: : I mean...{i}okay{/i} isn’t exactly accurate. I think it’s a complete invasion of privacy and it weirds me out, but...
lines.zh: : 我是说……说{i}「无所谓」{/i}并不准确。我觉得这完全是对隐私的侵犯，还让我觉得很不舒服，但是……

lines.en: : At the same time, it’s not like I can stop her from writing what she wants to write. I can just...not read it.
lines.zh: : 同时，我也没法阻止她写她想写的东西。我只能……不去看它。

lines.en: : Are you out of your mind?
lines.zh: : 你疯了吗？

lines.en: : Futaba?
lines.zh: : Futaba？

lines.en: scene futabatired11
: Are you out of your fucking mind?! Are {i}all{/i} of you insane?! Are all of you just {i}okay{/i} with this?!
lines.zh: : 你他妈疯了吗？！你们{i}全都{/i}疯了吗？！你们全都{i}能接受{/i}这种事？！

lines.en: : Hey, calm down. Someone is going to hear you.
lines.zh: : 嘿，冷静点。会有人听见的。

lines.en: : So you care about {i}that{/i} but not a detailed recollection of every single girl you’re involved with?! How does that make sense?!
lines.zh: : 所以你在意的是{i}那个{/i}，而不是对你染指过的每一个女孩的详细记录？！这说得通吗？！

lines.en: : What’s in {i}there{/i} is way more damning than anything {i}I{/i} could possibly say to you! I’m just one piece of the puzzle!
lines.zh: : {i}那里面{/i}写的东西，比{i}我{/i}能对你说出口的任何话都要命得多！我只是拼图里的其中一块！

lines.en: : Sure, but it’s still a {i}puzzle.{/i} You have to solve puzzles.
lines.zh: : 是没错，可它终究是一幅{i}拼图{/i}。拼图是得拼起来的。

lines.en: : Oh, give me a break! It’s a puzzle with like, twenty pieces max. Anyone in our class with half a brain will be able to figure out what her book really is by the second chapter.
lines.zh: : 哦，得了吧！那是一幅最多二十块的拼图。我们班上任何脑子有一半好使的人，到第二章就能猜出她那本书到底是什么。

lines.en: : Then I guess we should be thankful that only half of our class is smart.
lines.zh: : 那我想我们该庆幸，我们班只有一半的人聪明。

lines.en: scene futabatired12
: You and Nodoka both! How can you make jokes about this?! We’re {i}all{/i} screwed if the truth about this fucking book gets out!
lines.zh: : 你和 Nodoka 都是！这种事你们怎么还开得起玩笑？！要是这本该死的书的真相泄露出去，我们{i}全都{/i}要完蛋！

lines.en: : No, {i}I’m{/i} screwed if the truth about this book gets out. The rest of you will be fine.
lines.zh: : 不，要是这本书的真相泄露出去，完蛋的{i}是我{/i}。你们其他人不会有事。

lines.en: scene futabatired13

: Oh! Will we?! So people like Chika and Ami will just be totally cool with people like {i}me{/i} sleeping with you because {i}you’re{/i} taking the hit for all of us! Okay! I had no idea it worked that way!
lines.zh: : 哦！是吗？！所以像 Chika 和 Ami 这样的人，会因为{i}你{/i}在替我们所有人扛，就完全不介意像{i}我{/i}这样的人和你上床！好啊！我可不知道原来是这么运作的！

lines.en: : I...I guess I didn’t think of it like that.
lines.zh: : 我……我想我没往那个方向想过。

lines.en: : Yeah. Of course you didn’t. Because you already know the risks that come with doing what you do and you continue to do it anyway.
lines.zh: : 是啊。你当然没想过。因为你早就知道自己做的事伴随着什么风险，却还是继续做下去。

lines.en: : But do you think {i}I{/i} had any idea what I was getting into when I started hanging out with you? All I did was look up to you. I thought you were handsome and interesting.
lines.zh: : 可你觉得，{i}我{/i}一开始和你混在一起的时候，知道自己要卷进什么吗？我只是崇拜你。我觉得你又帅又有趣。

lines.en: : I had no fucking clue that you wanted me to suck your dick! And I also had no clue that I’d do it so easily, but here we are! Here we are, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 我他妈根本不知道你想要我给你口交！我也不知道自己会那么轻易就做了，可你看我们现在！我们现在就是这样了，Sensei！

lines.en: : Do you seriously think I’m ready for everyone else to find out about this? Do you think they’ll just let me off the hook because I’m {i}nice?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你真觉得我已经准备好让其他人知道这件事了吗？你觉得他们会因为我是个{i}好女孩{/i}就放过我吗？

lines.en: : Or do you think that {i}maybe{/i} this will make me a target again?! {i}I’m{/i} the outlier! {i}I’m{/i} the easiest one to come after! But we’re {i}all{/i} going to be fucked!
lines.zh: : 还是说你觉得这{i}也许{/i}会让我重新变成靶子？！{i}我{/i}是那个异类！{i}我{/i}是最好欺负的那个！可我们{i}全都{/i}要完蛋！

lines.en: : No one can read this! We have to put an end to it before it gets out of hand!
lines.zh: : 谁都不许读到这本书！我们必须在它失控之前把它了结！

lines.en: : There’s still time, though! We’re the only ones who know right now. And Rika. And I guess Molly and Yasu too, but they don’t really know the contents of-
lines.zh: : 不过还有时间！目前知道的只有我们。还有 Rika。我想还有 Molly 和 Yasu，不过她们并不真的知道里面的内容——

lines.en: : Rin and Otoha know too, Futaba.
lines.zh: : Rin 和 Otoha 也知道，Futaba。

lines.en: : I mean...why else would Rin have just left when you told her what was going on last night?
lines.zh: : 我是说……不然昨晚你跟她说发生了什么的时候，Rin 为什么转身就走了？

lines.en: scene futabatired14
: Hahah...
lines.zh: : 哈哈……

lines.en: : Hahahah...hahahah!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……哈哈哈！

lines.en: scene futabatired15
: Hahahaha! HAHAHAHAHA! AaaaaaaaAAAAAAHHHHHHHH!
lines.zh: : Hahahaha! HAHAHAHAHA! AaaaaaaaAAAAAAHHHHHHHH!

lines.en: : We’re all fucked and no one cares but me! Amazing!
lines.zh: : 我们全都要完蛋了，而除了我没有人在乎！真是了不起！

lines.en: : Futaba...how much of the book did you read, exactly? Because I know it’s about all of us, I just don’t really know the...{i}extent{/i} to which our “exploits” are included.
lines.zh: : Futaba……那本书你到底读了多少？因为我知道它是写我们所有人的，我只是不太清楚我们的「事迹」被写进去了{i}多少{/i}。

lines.en: : She knows everything. She knows literally everything because she’s a fucking genius and all she does is watch people.
lines.zh: : 她什么都知道。她真的什么都知道，因为她是个该死的天才，而她所做的全部事情就是观察人。

lines.en: : She knows how I think. She probably knows how {i}you{/i} think. She knows how {i}everyone{/i} thinks because she made it her reality. She can see into our heads, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 她知道我怎么想。她大概也知道{i}你{/i}怎么想。她知道{i}每个人{/i}怎么想，因为她把它变成了自己的现实。她能看进我们的脑子里，Sensei。

lines.en: : And you want to know the worst part?
lines.zh: : 而你想知道最糟的部分吗？

lines.en: scene futabatired16
: It’s {i}good.{/i}
lines.zh: : 它写得{i}很好{/i}。

lines.en: : It’s really...{i}really{/i} good.
lines.zh: : 真的……{i}真的{/i}很好。

lines.en: : I couldn’t even put it down. Well, at least not after the first time when I went into her room to yell at her. But after that, it was just straight to the end. And I loved it. But I also felt fucking {i}violated.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我甚至放不下它。至少在我第一次冲进她房间冲她吼之后就放不下了。但在那之后，我一口气读到了结尾。而我爱死它了。可我同时也觉得自己被彻底{i}侵犯{/i}了。

lines.en: : That’s why I didn’t sleep. I read the whole thing in one night. And I want to read it again. I want to know more about what everyone else thinks because I can...I can feel it changing the way {i}I{/i} do.
lines.zh: : 那就是我没睡觉的原因。我一晚上读完了整本。而我想再读一遍。我想知道更多关于其他人怎么想，因为我能……我能感觉到它正在改变{i}我{/i}的方式。

lines.en: : Futaba...what if the reason this is affecting you so much is because you’re Nodoka’s favorite?
lines.zh: : Futaba……有没有可能，它之所以对你影响这么大，是因为你是 Nodoka 最喜欢的人？

lines.en: scene futabatired17
: If I was her favorite, she wouldn’t include me at all! She wouldn’t just rewrite the things I told her in confidence! She wouldn’t just {i}give away{/i} my secrets!
lines.zh: : 如果我是她最喜欢的人，她就根本不会把我写进去！她就不会把我说给她听的悄悄话重新改写！她就不会把我的秘密{i}泄露出去{/i}！

lines.en: : But she did all of those things! And she did them {i}well!{/i}
lines.zh: : 可她全做了！而且还做得{i}很好{/i}！

lines.en: : But what I’m saying is she probably did them {i}well{/i} because she’s been watching you forever, hasn’t she? She knows how {i}you{/i} think because she knows {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 但我的意思是，她之所以做得{i}好{/i}，大概是因为她观察你已经很久了，不是吗？她知道{i}你{/i}怎么想，因为她了解{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: : And without knowing how anyone else reacts to this weird alternate reality she cooked up, we can’t know for sure just how accurate her re-tellings are.
lines.zh: : 而如果不知道别人对她编出来的这个诡异的平行现实作何反应，我们就无法确定她的复述到底有多准确。

lines.en: : There’s no way Nodoka can just {i}know{/i} things she wasn’t there for. So I imagine all of your parts are accurate because...well, you told her.
lines.zh: : Nodoka 不可能凭空{i}知道{/i}她不在场的事。所以我想，你的那些部分之所以准确，是因为……嗯，是你告诉她的。

lines.en: : You should read it, Sensei. You should find out. I only know so much, but you’ll know {i}everything.{/i} You’ll know what’s made up.
lines.zh: : 你应该读一读，Sensei。你应该去弄清楚。我知道的只有这么多，但你会知道{i}全部{/i}。你会知道哪些是编的。

lines.en: : Do you really think I want to read a book about all of the horrible things I’ve done? I’m a narcissist, not a masochist. There’s nothing I could gain from that book but reminders and regrets.
lines.zh: : 你真觉得我想读一本写满我做过的所有可怕事情的书吗？我是自恋狂，不是受虐狂。那本书能给我的，除了提醒和悔恨，什么都没有。

lines.en: : Do you regret me, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你后悔招惹我吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : Because right now, I’m regretting you.
lines.zh: : 因为现在，我正在后悔认识你。

lines.en: : And if the way you feel about me is at all what it’s like in the book, I...
lines.zh: : 而如果你对我的感觉哪怕有一点和书里写的一样，我……

lines.en: scene futabatired18
: I don’t even know...
lines.zh: : 我甚至不知道……

lines.en: : I knew I didn’t value myself. I’ve {i}never{/i} valued myself. And I gave away too much too early. But it was so much clearer when I was reading the book than it was in real life.
lines.zh: : 我知道我不看重自己。我{i}从来都不{/i}看重自己。而我太早就把太多东西交出去了。可在读那本书的时候，这一点比在现实里要清楚得多。

lines.en: : I’m the first one...the first one who caves...and I just...I let you {i}conquer{/i} me because I feel like you’ll leave me if I don’t.
lines.zh: : 我是第一个……第一个屈服的人……而我只是……我让你{i}征服{/i}了我，因为我觉得如果我不这样，你就会离开我。

lines.en: : I become so...reliant on your existence that...that...
lines.zh: : 我变得那么……依赖你的存在，以至于……以至于……

lines.en: : That it’s like I’m barely even human by the end of the first volume...
lines.zh: : 到第一卷结束的时候，我简直都不像个活人了……

lines.en: : If the other girls find out...if they see just how much of me I let you have...
lines.zh: : 如果其他女生发现了……如果她们看到我把多少的自己交给了你……

lines.en: scene futabatired19
: They’re going to hurt me...
lines.zh: : 她们会伤害我的……

lines.en: : I won’t let anyone hurt you, Futaba. And I’ll talk to Nodoka about her book. I had no idea it would affect anyone this much. Or that...any of you would even read it.
lines.zh: : 我不会让任何人伤害你，Futaba。我会去和 Nodoka 谈她那本书。我完全没想到它会影响到任何人这么深。也没想到……你们中会有任何人真的去读它。

lines.en: : Thank you...really.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你……真的。

lines.en: : But Sensei...this isn’t something you should wait on. If {i}anyone{/i} else from the class gets their hands on this, {i}everything{/i} is going to unravel.
lines.zh: : 可是 Sensei……这件事你不能拖。如果班上还有{i}别人{/i}拿到这本书，{i}一切{/i}都会土崩瓦解。

lines.en: : Unless a good portion of it is made up, you mean.
lines.zh: : 你的意思是，除非其中很大一部分是编的。

lines.en: : But if the others are anything like me...and they can {i}confirm{/i} that what’s in there actually happened...everyone will know it’s real.
lines.zh: : 但如果其他人哪怕有一点像我……而她们能{i}证实{/i}里面写的事确实发生过……所有人都会知道那是真的。

lines.en: : All it takes is one person’s confirmation to cast doubt on any part of the story that you or Nodoka or anyone else says is just “made up.”
lines.zh: : 只需要一个人的证实，就足以让那些你、Nodoka 或者任何人口口声声说只是「编的」的部分受到质疑。

lines.en: : I get it. Like I said, I’ll talk to her.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。就像我说的，我会去和她谈。

lines.en: scene futabatired20
: That’s great, but...why didn’t you talk to {i}me?{/i}
lines.zh: : 那很好，可是……你为什么不来跟{i}我{/i}说？

lines.en: : Why didn’t {i}any{/i} of you talk to me?...
lines.zh: : 为什么你们{i}谁都{/i}不来跟我说？……

lines.en: : You all knew...you all knew that I’d bare everything in this book...that some of the biggest, most important moments of my life would be put on display...{i}highlighted...{/i}for everyone to see...
lines.zh: : 你们全都知道……你们全都知道我会在这本书里袒露一切……知道我生命中一些最大、最重要的时刻会被摊开展示……{i}被高亮标出{/i}……让所有人看见……

lines.en: : Do you really think that’s what a girl like {i}me{/i} wants?...To have {i}more{/i} people look at her when she can’t even look at herself?
lines.zh: : 你们真觉得像{i}我{/i}这样的女孩想要的是这个吗？……在她连看都不敢看自己一眼的时候，让{i}更多{/i}人来看她？

lines.en: : Did any of you even think about that?...
lines.zh: : 你们有谁哪怕想过这一点吗？……

lines.en: : Honestly?...No. I don’t think any of us did. Because if there was even a glimpse of that, we would have confronted Nodoka then and there.
lines.zh: : 老实说？……没有。我想我们谁都没想过。因为哪怕我们有一丁点想到，当场就会去找 Nodoka 对质了。

lines.en: : But this was something that was out before any of us could even do anything about it. Rin, Otoha, and I didn’t find out what was going on until people started mistaking us for cosplayers.
lines.zh: : 但这东西在我们任何人能采取行动之前就已经面世了。Rin、Otoha 和我，直到开始有人把我们错认成 coser 才明白发生了什么。

lines.en: : Well...for all of our sakes...I hope you get through to her. Because I thought I would...and I didn’t even come close.
lines.zh: : 嗯……为了我们所有人……我希望你能说服她。因为我以为我能……结果我连边都没沾上。

lines.en: : I’ll do my best. It’s Nodoka, though...so I can’t really make any promises.
lines.zh: : 我会尽力。不过那是 Nodoka……所以我实在没法打包票。

lines.en: : I do have one question, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我还有一个问题。

lines.en: : What is it?...What are you wondering?...
lines.zh: : 什么问题？……你在好奇什么？……

lines.en: : It’s just...our story is still going.
lines.zh: : 只是……我们的故事还在继续。

lines.en: : So I was kind of wondering how the book ended.
lines.zh: : 所以我有点好奇那本书是怎么结尾的。

lines.en: : Like...where did she decide to cut things off?
lines.zh: : 比如……她决定从哪里切断？

lines.en: : That’s the only part I didn’t really understand.
lines.zh: : 那是唯一一部分我不太明白的。

lines.en: : The book just...{i}ends.{/i}
lines.zh: : 那本书就……{i}结束{/i}了。

lines.en: : But...{i}where{/i} does it end?
lines.zh: : 可是……它结束在{i}哪里{/i}？

lines.en: : What’s the last thing that happens?
lines.zh: : 最后发生的事是什么？

lines.en: scene futabatired21
: You wake up in a room with clocks.
lines.zh: : 你在一个满是钟的房间里醒来。

lines.en: scene black
FUTABA GOES HOME TO SLEEP AND FEELS A LOT BETTER ONCE SHE WAKES UP
lines.zh: FUTABA 回家睡觉，醒来之后感觉好多了

lines.zh: 放学后你试图做同样的事，但你的任务变成了实体，卡在了厨房台面的边角上

lines.en: YOU FORGET WHAT IT WAS YOU WERE SUPPOSED TO DO AND WHO YOU WERE SUPPOSED TO TALK TO
lines.zh: 你忘了自己该做什么，也忘了该去找谁谈
